FALSE-NEGATIVE IN THE PROPOSED EXTRACTOR. The stated rule keeps tokens that 'contain a slash and end in a known extension or a slash'. `.githooks/pre-commit` has a slash, no extension and no trailing slash, so it is DROPPED and never resolved - the single most load-bearing path in the Quality gate section would be unchecked if the hook were renamed. probe4.mjs enumerates 26 such dropped tokens; 5 of them are real paths that exist today and would go unguarded: CLAUDE.md:66 `.githooks/pre-commit`, RESUME_HERE.md:28 `src/core/npc`, RESUME_HERE.md:76 `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md.bak-20260914`, RESUME_HERE.md:454 `docs/gauntlet/L0`, docs/research/HARNESS.md:255 `~/kheshav-code`. Extend the rule to 'contains a slash AND (has an extension OR trailing slash OR resolves as a directory)', or the count floor will happily sit at 148 while the extractor blinds itself to extensionless paths.
